No other token activates it (the next-highest vocabulary item reaches only ~0.32 against the 5.5 scale and the 1.38 activity line) and the surrounding text shifts its strength by at most ~0.6, so a text is predicted active iff it contains a newline token or '<|endoftext|>', and inactive otherwise however it is punctuated, indented, or broken with tabs, carriage returns, U+2028 or an HTML
